mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and new housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a key component of consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% annually), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (annualized), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 3 months indicates a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When new housing starts fall below 1,350,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1350.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown in the supply sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side slowdown regime (defined by INDPRO declining for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate output and earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
